description: Test class for MapBasedDeviceConnectionService, containing unit tests for device gateway mapping functionalities using JUnit 5 and Mockito in a Vert.x environment.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of MapBasedDeviceConnectionService class methods related to device gateway last known mapping.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes testing fixtures before each test, mocking dependencies and setting up the service instance.

methods.name: testSetAndGetLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Verifies setting and retrieving the last known gateway for a device functions correctly.

methods.name: testGetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceNotFound
methods.description: Confirms that retrieving a last known gateway for a device with no entry returns a not found status.

methods.name: testSetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceFailsIfLimitReached
methods.description: Tests that setting a last known gateway fails with a forbidden status if maximum device entries for tenant are reached.
